dataset: NOAA NCEI GSOD, station 03204099999 (ISLE OF MAN, EGNS/Ronaldsway)
limitations: Airport surface weather, not offshore sea state or wave height.
GMT daily summaries; variable observation counts and missing days/values. Means use available values only.
Partial final year; unavailable source files are explicitly listed.
No overlap is assumed with the autumn 2026 sailing snapshot; no cancellation association or prediction is fitted.
Not a complete archive of every Isle of Man climate or tide record.
